env_allowlist.HOME: runner home used only to address the hash-verified Elan Lake launcher

recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs inside Bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, fixed locale/timezone/thread count, and only a fresh temporary module directory writable. The recipe invokes no update, build, clone, or fetch.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact nine-line UTF-8 PASS/FAIL-CLOSED summary bound by validation-receipt.json

recipes.scope_boundary: Network-isolated, trust-zero, fresh-output worker replay of the exact frozen root and proof architecture, parser-aware local hygiene, a transitive declaration/trust observation, and selected pinned source/compiled provenance. The exact-type aliases add no mathematical proof. Proof master acceptance, an accepted foundation/TCB profile, complete provenance/SBOM, clean empty-cache cold replay, and distinct signed independent verification remain fail-closed.

status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests a truthful blocked validation packet only. It cannot accept the proof prerequisite, promote the pre-proof graph, establish release-grade E0, or claim AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, theorem completion, or master acceptance.
